title: Strategic Disclosure of Action Space in Principal-Agent Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2609.25410v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study strategic disclosure of the action space in principal-agent contracting, where an agent selects a disclosed action set to shape the principal's perception of her capabilities before contract design. Unaware of the strategic disclosure, the principal designs a revenue-optimal contract as if the disclosed action set were complete and accurate. We consider two variants distinguished by cost verifiability. When costs are unverifiable, the agent can extract the entire first-best surplus, leaving the principal with zero revenue. When costs are verifiable, we characterize the agent's optimal disclosure strategy in binary-outcome settings and, more generally, when the principal is restricted to linear contracts, reducing the agent's problem to a two-variable convex optimization problem. translated_title: 委托-代理合同中行动空间的策略性披露
translated_abstract: 我们研究委托-代理合同中行动空间的策略性披露问题，其中代理人在合同设计之前选择一个披露的行动集合，以塑造委托人对其能力的认知。委托人并未察觉这种策略性披露，会将披露的行动集合视为完整且准确的信息来设计收益最优的合同。我们考虑了以成本可验证性区分的两种变体。当成本不可验证时，代理人可以获取全部的一阶最优剩余，使委托人的收益为零。当成本可验证时，我们刻画了代理人在二元结果设定下的最优披露策略；更一般地，当委托人被限制只能使用线性合同时，我们将代理人的问题简化为一个两变量凸优化问题。我们证明代理人可以确保获得至少一阶最优剩余的 $1/e$ 比例的效用，这也在最优合同下带来了 $1/e$ 的福利保证。
tldr: 该论文研究了委托-代理合同中代理人通过策略性披露行动集合来误导委托人合同设计的问题，证明当成本不可验证时代理人可攫取全部一阶最优剩余，而当成本可验证或委托人限于线性合同时，代理人至少能保证获得一阶最优剩余的1/e。
en_tdlr: This paper studies strategic disclosure of the action space in principal-agent contracting, proving that the agent can extract the entire first-best surplus when costs are unverifiable, and can secure at least a 1/e fraction of it when costs are verifiable or when the principal is restricted to linear contracts.
